        SALAMANDER GRAND PIANO V3 AUDIO ATTRIBUTION

        The browser fetches 14 MP3 piano recordings from:
        https://tonejs.github.io/audio/salamander/

        Original instrument recording: Salamander Grand Piano V3
        Artist/recordist: Alexander Holm
        Instrument: Yamaha C5 Grand Piano
        Original source: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano
        License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0)
        License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

        The downloaded MP3 files are stored in `dist/assets/piano-*.mp3` and served
        from this site. The website repitches neighboring notes and applies note gain
        envelopes and light output filtering.

        The software uses a selected single sample per anchor note; it does not
        include the complete original 16-layer velocity sample bank.
